tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can gyi gzungs kyi rgyas 'grel bzhugs/

༈ na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ gsal rdzogs mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar sku ni rab mdzes gser gyi lhun po bzhin/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnga'i gsung ni tshangs dbyangs 'bum phrag sgrogs pa bzhin/ /chos kun thogs med mngon gzigs thugs ni nyin byed bye ba shar ba bzhin/ /lha mi'i ston pa gang de'i zhabs sen spyi bo'i pad+mor rtag rol zhig /gang gi mtshan mchog gtsug tor nor bu las 'khrungs shing*/ /gzhan gyis mi thub gtsug tor gdugs dkar zhes grags gang*/ /dbu zhal phyag stong bye ba brgya stong spyan ldan pa/ /mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can der 'dud kyis skyongs/ ༈ /de la 'dir gdugs dkar po can mchog tu grub pa zhes yongs su grags pa 'di'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ gzhung don bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ com ldan 'das kyis mdo sngags gnyis dang*/ sngags la rgyud sde bzhi gsungs pa'i nang nas bya rgyud du gtogs pa la/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs gnyis kyi dang po 'das pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs gsum las/ dang po ni/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni dpag med kyi rgyud dang*/ gsum pa ni mi 'khrugs pa'i rgyud lta bu ste/ de yang rigs kyi gtso bo'i dbang du byas la/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang*/ phyag stong spyan stong gi rgyud dang*/ phyag rdor dang rnam 'joms kyi rgyud lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi yum dang*/ rigs kyi gtsug tor sogs mang du yod cing*/ gtsug tor la yang gtsug tor dri med/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar sogs mang ngo*/ /gdugs dkar la yang gzhan gyi mi thub pa dang*/ phyi zlog ma dang*/ mchog tu grub pa rnams las 'dir phyi ma ni gang bshad par bya ba'i chos so/ /gnyis pa gzhung don bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum/

klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gnyis/ mtshan gyi don dang*/ 'gyur gyi phyag go /dang po la gnyis/ mtshan bstan pa dang*/ mtshan bsgyur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du nas nā ma dhā ra ṇi zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di la rgya gar zhes pa ni 'phags yul na mnyan yod la sogs pa grong khyer chen po drug yod pa de la rgya gar zhes 'dod rgyal du btags pa ste/ dper na bum pa dang ka ba zhes btags pa bzhin no/ /kha cig rgya nag las gar bas rgya gar zhes dang*/ rgya dkar nag gnyis su phye ba'i rgya dkar po yin pas rgya gar zhes brjod pa'o zhes zer ba ni mkhas pa gzhan gyis bkag pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgya gar de na skad rigs chen po bzhi yod pa las/ legs sbyar gyi skad du/ ār+ya ta thā ga to ṣ+ṇīṣa zhes sogs yin zhing*/ bod kyi skad du bsgyur na 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor zhes pa nas/ gzungs zhes bya ste/ ar+ya ni 'phags pa/ /ta thā ni de bzhin/ ga ta ni gshegs pa/ u ṣī ṣa ni gtsug tor/ si tā ni dkar po/ /ta pa tre ni gdugs/ a pa rā dzi ta ni gzhan gyi mi thub pa'o/ /de yang pa rā ni gzhan/ dzi ta ni thub pa ste/ a 'gag tshig tu mdzad nas mi thub pa'o/ /ma hā pra t+yaṅgī ra ni phyir zlog pa chen mo ste/ pra ti ni phyir/ aṅgi ra ni zlog pa'o/ /de yang ta'i srog gi i ni/ a dang 'phrad nas mtshams sbyor lnga pa las/ dbyangs la i la'o zhes 'byung ba ltar i yar bsgyur nas mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /pa ra ma ni mchog tu/ sid+dha ni grub pa/ nā ma ni zhes bya ba/ dhā ra ṇi ni gzungs zhes bya bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'gyur phyag ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' zhes pa nas/ gtsug tor rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa ste lo ts+tsha bas bkod pa'o/ /'di la gnyis las dang po ni/ 'di dag gi don bsdus te bshad na/ ma rig bag chags dang bcas pa'i gnyid las sangs shing shes bya thams cad la blo rgyas pas sangs rgyas zhes bya ste/

ji skad du/ ma rig gnyid las sangs phyir dang*/ /shes bya la yang blo rgyas phyir/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma ltar sangs rgyas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rnams mkhyen don du gnyer zhing sems pas na byang chub sems dpa'/ so skye'i sa las 'das shing 'phags pas na 'phags pa/ rten 'brel zab mo'i chos sangs rgyas la nyan cing thos par byed pas na nyan thos/ rang gcig pur gnas pa la dga' zhing srid pa tha ma'i tshe gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ma bltos par rang gi byang chub mngon du byed cing nyon mongs pa las rgyal bar byed pas na rang rgyal zhes bya ste de thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba ni yid gus pas 'dud pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gzhan gyi mi thub pa gtsug tor rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa ste don ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ gling gzhi phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ chos phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba'i mthun 'gyur ro/ /dang po la bzhi/ dus dang*/ ston pa dang*/ gnas dang*/ 'khor ro/ /dang po ni/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzhung 'di skad sdud pa po phyag rdor bdag gis thos so/ /de ni yang yang thos pa min gyi/ thos pa'i dus gcig na zhes pa ni lan gcig tsam thos pa ste/ dus gcig gi tshe 'di thos kyi/ dus gzhan la ni gzhan thos so/ /de yang dus gcig la lan gcig tsam thos pas yin la 'dzin nus par bstan pas rnyed dka' ba dang shes rab che ba go la dus gzhan la gzhung gzhan thos pa dang sbyar na thos pa mang bar go'o/ /gnyis pa ston pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa ste/ sgrib gnyis dang bdud bzhi bcom pa'am spangs pas na bcom zhes bya zhing*/ de dag bcom pa'i spangs rtogs rang rgyud la mnga' bas na ldan zhes bya'o/ /yang skal ba drug dang ldan pas na ldan zhes bya ste/ ji skad du/ dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang*/ /brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/

/drug po rnams la skal zhes bya/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /bcom ldan gyi skad dod bha ga wan zhes pa ni skal ldan dang bcom ldan gnyis ka la 'jug cing*/ 'das pa'i tshig dngos su med kyang 'dir don gyis thob pas lo ts+tsha bas bsnan pa'o/ /gsum pa gnas ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i gnas te/ de ni ri rab lhun po'i rtse mo na yod de/ mdzod las/ lhun po'i rtse na sum cu gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sum cu rtsa gsum zhes pa ni brgya byin dang 'khor nye dbang so gnyis dang bcas pa'i so gsum gnas pa la byed pa yin te/ nye dbang so gnyis ni/ nor lha brgyad/ drag po bcu gcig /nyi ma bcu gnyis/ tha skar gyi bu gnyis dang bcas pa yin la/ 'di rnams kyi ngos 'dzin ni tshig gter 'grel pa las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /lhun po'i rtse'i dbus na grong khyer lta na sdug ces pa gru bzhi ngos re re dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya re yod cing*/ lta na sdug gi dbus na brgya byin gyi khang bzang rnam par rgyal byed yod la/ de'i phyi rol lho nub mtshams na chos bzang lha'i 'dun sa zhes pa yod de/ de'i ngos rer dpag tshad sum brgya re yod cing*/ nang du brgya byin gyi gser khri dang*/ nye dbang so gnyis kyi khri rnams yod do/ /de lta bu'i lha'i gnas chos bzang lha'i 'dun sa de na dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i tshe 'di gsungs so/ /sum cu rtsa gsum du 'byon pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo dus byas nas lhar skyes pa de nyid bden pa mthong ba la 'god pa'i ched du der byon nas dbyar gnas mdzad de chos bstan nas yum gyi skye ba sogs lha mang po bden pa mthong ba la bkod do/ /bzhi pa 'khor ni/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen mo dang zhes pa'i dge slong la tshur shog dang gsol bzhi'i las kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa sogs mang yang*/ 'dir rdzu ྄྄'phrul dang ldan pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun mang po la sbyar bar bya ste/

bcom ldan 'das lha gnas su 'byon pa'i dus su 'khor du dge slong rdzu 'phrul thob pa dang lhan cig byon par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /dge 'dun yang dge slong bzhi tshogs la dge 'dun zhes pa'i tha snyad dang*/ 'phags pa'i gang zag so so ba la yang dge 'dun zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa gnyis so/ /dge 'dun gyi sgra don ni/ dge ba thar ba sgrub par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa can yin pa'o/ /chen po zhes pa ni spangs rtogs kyi yon tan chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa'i gang zag gi dbang du mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po zhes pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sgra don gyi phyogs gcig gong du brjod pa ltar yin la/ dge 'dun dang chen po ni bshad ma thag pa ltar ro/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang zhes pa'i sgra don ni/ sngon mchod sbyin chen po brgya phrag gcig byas pas brgya byin gyi go 'phang thob par bshad pa ltar te/ de rnams dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa ni lhan cig tu'o/ /de dag ni sdud pa pos mthong ba'i don bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa chos phun sum tshogs pa la gnyis/ ston pas gsang sngags kyi tshig dbyung ba'i phyir ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pa dang*/ gsang sngags ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dus de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das seṅge'i khri gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas rang gi gtsug tor nas 'chad pa ltar gyi gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams dbyung bar bya'o snyam pa'i thugs rtse gcig pa'i gtsug tor rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /gnyis pa ji ltar gsungs tshul la gnyis/ gang nas gsungs pa'i mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ de nas ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul dngos so/ /dang po ni/ de ltar snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor gyi dbus nas gsang sngags kyi tshig 'chad 'gyur 'di dag phyung ngo*/ /gsang sngags kyi don la rgyas bshad mang yang*/

sgra don ni/ snod min la gsang zhing sbas grub pa ste/ de la lha dang lam gyi rim pa gnyis dang*/ rjod byed tshig gi gsang sngags dang*/ brjod bya don gyi gsang sngags kyang gnyis so/ /gzungs 'di gtsug tor nas gsungs pa gsal bar bshad pa ltar yin la/ der ma zad/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzod spu/ mgrin pa/ thugs ka lte ba/ gsang gnas sogs sku'i cha thams cad dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas chos ston nus par gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las bshad cing*/ de'i don bsdus pa ni bstod sprin rgya mtsho las/ spyi gtsug mdzod spu mgrin pa la sogs khyer sku'i cha shas kun nas 'byung bar rab ston kyang*/ /de dag kun la rtog pa nyer zhi 'di ni nam mkhas tshangs dbyangs sgrogs na mtshon par nus/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang sangs rgyas kyi sku'i cha dang ye shes gnyis ngo bo gcig yin pas te/ mtshan brjod las/ sgra yang rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /zhes sogs dang*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ kun tu phyag dang zhabs ldan zhing*/ /kun tu spyan dang dbu dang zhal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ gsang sngags 'grub pa'i ched du phyag 'os la phyag bya ba dang*/ sngags la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa dang*/ de la bsgom bzlas bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes sogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi sgra don sngar ltar dang*/ yang 'jug pa las/ de nyid rgyas la sangs rgyas bsnyad ji bzhin/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar de kho na nyid la blo rgyas pas na sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi skad dod dharmāḥzhes pa'i dha ra 'dzin pa la 'jug pas dam pa'i chos 'gog lam gnyis kyis gdul bya rnams nyes ltung dang 'khor ba dang ngan 'gro las 'dzin pas na chos so/ /spyir chos kyi sgra ni don bcu la 'jug ste/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ chos ni shes bya lam dang ni/ myang ngan 'das dang yid kyi yul/ /bsod nams tshe dang gsung rab dang*/

/'byung 'gyur nges dang chos lugs la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dge 'dun ni gong du bshad pa ltar yin yang*/ gzhung kha cig tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang thar ba la 'dun pa dang bdud sogs kyis dbye bar mi nus shing mi phyed pas na dge 'dun du brjod ces bshad/ /phyag 'tshal ba'i don ni bshad zin la/ de dag gis skyabs gsum la phyag 'tshal ba spyir bstan na/ bye brag tu spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad yang dag par yongs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang*/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal ba ni mdor bstan pa'o/ /bye ba phrag bdun ni bye ba bdun te/ de yang brgya/ stong*/ khri/ 'bum/ sa ya/ bye ba rnams snga ma snga ma bcu 'gyur la phyi ma phyi ma'i grangs 'byung zhing*/ bye ba bcu la ni dung 'phyur gcig go /byang chub sems dpa'i nang nas sgos su byams pa la sogs pa'i sogs kyi sgras 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor sogs rgyal sras brgyad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan thams cad kyang sdud do/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni rang don byang chub chos sku don du gnyer ba dang*/ sems dpa' chen po ni gzhan don gzugs sku don du gnyer ba'i sgo nas brjod pa'o/ /byams 'jam dbyangs sogs nye ba'i sras chen brgyad ni mdo phyogs dang rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lugs la byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bzung ba la de'i ming gis brjod pa ltar byang chub sems dpar re zhig khas len pa yin gyi/ dngos po'i gnas tshod dang bla med kyi lugs la 'di dag sangs rgyas su nges par 'dod dgos te lung dang rigs pa mang ngo*/ /nyan thos kyi dge 'dun so sor phye ste phyag 'tshal ba ni/ mi rtag cing 'jig pa'i rten yin pas na snod kyi 'jig rten 'di na bzhugs pa nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa 'dis nyan rang dgra bcom pa gnyis ka bsdus nas bstan kyang gtso bo ni nyan thos dgra bcom pa la bya ste/

gzhung gong 'og gnyis kas 'bras gnas bzhi ston par snang ba'i phyir ro/ /'dis dgra bcom 'bras gnas bstan nas 'bras gnas gzhan gsum ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa dang*/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang*/ phyir mi 'ong zhes pa rnams kyis 'chad do/ /spyir rgyun zhugs zhugs pa dang rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gnyis/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang de'i 'bras gnas gnyis/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa dang de'i 'bras gnas gnyis/ dgra bcom zhugs pa dang de'i 'bras gnas gnyis te skyes bu zung bzhi dang gang zag ya brgyad do/ /zhugs 'bras bzhi'i skor la mang du bshad par bya ba mchis kyang*/ mtshon tsam ni/ 'jig lta/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin/ the tshom nyon mongs can kun btags gsum spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson pa'i rgyun zhugs zhugs pa dang*/ de gsum spangs pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gnyis/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi sgom spangs nyon mongs la chung 'bring chen po gsum dang de re re la yang gsum gsum du phye ba'i 'dod nyon drug pa spong phyir du zhugs pa'i phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang*/ de drug pa spangs pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas dang*/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spong phyir du zhugs pa'i phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa dang*/ de dgu ba spangs pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas gnyis/ dgra bcom zhugs 'bras gnyis ni/ srid rtse'i nyon mongs dgu pa spong phyir du zhugs pa dang spangs pa'i sgo nas 'jog go / rgyun tu zhugs pa zhes pa ni thar lam gyi rgyun la dang por zhugs pa dang*/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba ni dgra bcom ma thob pa'i sngon du 'dod par las nyon gyis skye ba lan gcig len pa'i don yin la/ phyir mi 'ong ba ni tshe de nas bzung ste dgra bcom ma thob bar du 'dod par las nyon gyis skye ba mi len pa'o/ /mngon pa kun btus ltar na/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa la skye 'phags gnyis yod kyang*/ mdzod kyi lugs la de thams cad kyang nyan thos 'phags pa'o/

/yang dag par song ba dang*/ yang dag par zhugs zhes pa gnyis kyis snga ma'i don bsdus nas bstan pa ste yang dag par song ba rnams ni 'bras bu thob pa'i 'bras gnas rnams dang*/ yang dag par zhugs pa rnams ni 'bras bu de dag thob phyir du zhugs pa'o/ /lha'i drang srong rnams ni a ga sta la sogs pa'o/ /de nas rigs sngags 'chang grub pa zhes pa ni 'jig rten pa'i rig sngags grub pa thams cad de/ thun mong pa'i dngos grub thob pa rnams so/ /tshangs pa la stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa dang*/ stong spyi phud kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang phyogs skyong gi nang tshan gyi tshangs pa ste snga ma ni chen po dang phyi ma gnyis chung ba'o/ /dbang po la che chung gnyis te/ che ba sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bdag po yin la/ chung ba ni phyogs skyong gi nang tshan shar phyogs skyong bar bshad do/ /legs ldan drag po ni dbang phyug chen po yin la/ dka' thub zlog ma ni lha mo u ma ste/ des rang gi bdag po dbang phyug gi dka' thub zlog par byed pas so/ /dbang phyug chen po la bzhi yod pa bu ston rin po ches bshad cing*/ che chung gnyis yod par tshig gter 'grel pa las bshad de/ che ba ni gangs te se dang*/ chung ba ni byang shar dbang ldan gyi bdag po ste/ 'on kyang ngo bo gcig yin par mngon no/ /legs ldan sred med kyi bu ni khyab 'jug ste/ 'di gza' khyab 'jug min gyi lha yin te lha'i gtso bo la tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug gsum bshad pa'i phyi ma de'o/ /nye dbang nag po nam mkha' lding la zhon pa yang 'di yin par bshad/ phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas zhais pa'i don rgya chen rigs bzhi dang dga' rab dbang phyug dang bcas pa lngas phyag byas par slob dpon shu rāṅga badz+ras 'chad/ tshangs pa dang dbang po dang dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug bzhi la ming gi rnam grangs mang po zhig mngon brjod las 'byung ste/ tshangs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs ni/

tshig gter las/ tshangs pa skyes bdag lha las rgan/ /mes po mchog gnas gser gyi mngal/ /zhes sogs bcwo brgyad dang*/ dbang po'i ming ni/ dbang po dang ni ma ru ta/ /zhes sogs so bzhi dang*/ dbang phyug gi ming ni/ bde 'byung dbang phyug phyug bdag dang*/ /zhes sogs lnga bcu'i skor dang*/ khyab 'jug gi ming ni/ khyab 'jug mi yi theg pa dang*/ /zhes sogs so dgu bshad cing*/ 'grel bar de las mang pa zhig bshad do/ /legs ldan nag po chen po lha ma yin gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed pa po ni mgon po beng ste/ de ni dur khrod na gnas par mos shing tshangs ma dang dbang mo la sogs ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa'o/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed pa 'di la mgon po phyag drug pa dang dbang phyug chen po gnyis kyang snang ngo*/ /gdung bdun gyi skabs 'dir 'chad tshul gnyis mthong ste/ rgya 'grel shu rāṅga badz+ra gyis mdzad pa las/ sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs sam gdung*/ gtsug tor can pad+ma'i gdung*/ thams cad skyob rdo rje'i gdung*/ 'khor ba 'jig nor bu'i gdung*/ gser thub glang po'i gdung*/ 'od srung gzhon nu'i gdung*/ shākya thub klu'i gdung rigs su bshad la/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung ngam rigs ni 'jam dpal dang grwa lnga mi g.yo ba sogs dang*/ pad+ma'i gdung ni spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma rta mgrin sogs dang*/ rdo rje'i gdung ni phyag rdor dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sogs dang*/ nor bu'i gdung ni rnam sras dang nor bu bzang po sogs dang*/ glang bo'i gdung ni lngas rtsen dang 'phrog ma la sogs pa dang*/ gzhon nu'i gdung ni smin drug gi bu'i rigs dang*/ klu'i gdung ngam rigs ni nor rgyal la sogs pa'o zhes bshad de/ de gnyis ka la'ang brtag par bya ba'i gnas su snang ste re zhig gang rung ngo*/ /'on kyang 'di thams cad kyi thog mar bcom ldan 'das zhes 'byung bas phyi ma cung bde bar mi sems yang*/

de rnams kyi rigs tsam la ni 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das gnyis 'byung ba mi 'gal la/ snga mas gdung da ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig bshad 'dug pa ni ma nges pa'i sgrub byed du snang ngo*/ /de nas bde gshegs bcu la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ni bshad zin la/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni de bzhin nyid ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs shing mngon du mdzad pa'o/ /slob dpon shu rāṅga badz+ra gyis sangs rgyas bcu'i nang gi sman bla lho phyogs na bzhugs par bshad pa ni gzhan nas de shar na bzhugs par bshad pa dang mi mthun la/ shāka thub byang na bzhugs par bshad pa ltar na 'di bdag cag gi ston pa min par sems yang bshad pa de la yid brtan dka' bar snang ngo*/ /gnyis pa sngags la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub tshul la lnga/ dkyil 'khor sngags dang bcas pa bshad pa/ mi shis pa sbyang ba/ snying po dang thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags brjod nas bar chad srung zhing sel ba/ nye snying phan yon dang bcas pa bshad pa/ sngags char 'bab bcas bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ khro mo bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor sngags bcas bshad pa dang*/ lha mo bcu gcig gi dkyil 'khor sngags bcas bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ nus pa'i yon tan brjod pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha grangs bstan pa/ srung ba'i sngags bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyag yul de rnams la phyag btsal nas zhes mtshams sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i mtshan mchog dbu'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes pa phyag mtshan gyi sgo nas mtshan btags shing*/ bdud dang bgegs la sogs gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ de thams cad phyir zlog pa chen mo 'di ni/ nus pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par 'byung po'i gdon thams cad tshar gcod par byed pa/ pha rol gzhan gyi rig sngags kyi nus pa thams cad gcod par byed pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i gnod pa las zlog par byed pa/

sems can gsod pa dang*/ lcags sgrog sogs kyis bcings pa thams cad las dgrol bar byed pa/ gzhan gyis sdang ba dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa thams cad zlog par byed pa/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gdon dang gdon stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'jig pa ste zhi bar byed pa'o/ /stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ni brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo*/ /da lta gdon rigs sum brgya drug cur grags kyang mi 'gal zhing rags pa'i sde tshan ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ phyogs bzhir bya ba byed pa la bzang ba'i dbang du mdzad nas/ smin drug snar ma mgo lag nabs so rgyal skag ste shar skar bdun dang*/ mchu gre dbo me bzhi nag pa sa ri sa ga ste lho skar bdun dang*/ lha mtshams snron snubs chu stod chu smad bye bzhin gro bzhin te nub skar bdun dang*/ mon gre mon gru khrums stod khrums smad tha skar bra nye ste byang skar bdun bcas nyer brgyad po thams cad dga' bar byed pa/ nyi ma zla ba mig dmar lhag pa phur bu pa sangs spen pa sgra gcan te gza' chen po brgyad 'jig pa'am 'joms par byed pa/ phas rgol gyi dgra thams cad phyir zlog par byed pa/ sems can ma rungs pa dang*/ sdang sems can dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa gtong ba thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ dug dang mtshon cha'i gnod pa thams cad dang*/ me dang chu'i gnod pa las zlog par byed pa/ phyi ma'i ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa thams cad las sgrol bar byed pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /'dir rgyu skar rnams dga' ba dang*/ gza' rnams 'jig par byed pa'i khyad par ci zhe na/ rgyu skar rnams lha mo yin pa la dgongs par sems so/ /gnyis pa lha grangs bstan pa ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi lte ba dang*/ rtsibs brgyad dang grwa bzhi dang sgo bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan gsum gsum/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du khro mo gzhan gyis mi thub ma drag shul chen mo sku mdog nag mo phyag g.yas rdo rje/

rtsibs brgyad la shar du gtum pa chen mo stobs chen mo dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo/ lhor 'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid che ser mo g.yas rdo rje/ nub tu dkar mo chen mo gzi brjid 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba can gos dkar mo'i ngo bo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma/ byang du 'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can ljang khu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ byang shar du rgyal ba'i rdo rje 'phreng ba can du grags pa sngon mo g.yas dbyug pa/ shar lhor pad+ma'i mngon mtshan ser mo g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag mtshan can/ lho nub tu gzhan gyis mi thub ma dmar mo g.yas rdo rje'i phreng ba can/ nub byang du rdo rje mchu can rnam sgeg ma ljang khu g.yas ral gri dang*/ phyi'i shar lhor zhi ba lha rnams kyis mchod ma dkar mo g.yas spos snod/ lho nub tu zhi ba ma ser mo g.yas gser gyi phreng ba can/ nub byang du dkar chen 'bar ba gos dkar mo can dkar dmar g.yas mar me/ byang shar du 'phags ma sgrol ma stobs mo che ljang khu g.yas dri'i dung chos dang*/ shar sgor rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ lho sgor rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa/ nub sgor lag na rdo rje'i rigs gser gyi phreng ba can dmar mo g.yas lcags kyu/ byang sgor rdo rje rin chen ma leb rgan rtsi dmar ljang g.yas dril bu 'dzin pa/ bcu bdun po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rnams kyis phyag mtshan 'phyar stabs dang*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan cing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ khro mo'i cha lugs can g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /lha mo de thams cad kyang rnam par snang mdzad kyi rigs dang de'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs pas rdo rje'i gtsug tor gyi rigs su grags so/ /gsum pa ni/ phyag rgya ste lha'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de rnams kyi sngags kyi tshogs ni 'chad 'gyur ltar sngags kyi tshogs sam/

yang na phyag rgya gtso mo dang sngags kyi tshogs 'khor gyi lha de dag thams cad kyis/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang sems can thams cad srung du gsol zhes pa ni gsol 'debs pa'o/ /sngags don la/ oṃ ni bkra shis pa dang mchog sogs don bdun la 'jug cing sngags kyi 'go 'dren no/ /sarba thā ga to ṣ+ṇīṣa si tā ta pa tre ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can zhes pa ste so sor phye na sngar bshad pa ltar ro/ /dzam+bha na ka rī ni rmugs par byed pa ste de yang dzam+bha na ni rmugs pa/ ka rī ni byed pa'o/ /rmugs pa'i don ni sngags kyis sems blun par byed pa'o/ /stam+bha na ka rī ni des lus rengs par byed pa/ mo ha na ka rī ni des yid rmongs par byed pa/ lam+bha na ka rī ni bskrod par byed pa/ ba ha na ka rī ni dbye bar byed pa/ pa ra pi ṣa bhak+ṣa ṇa ka ri ni pha rol gyi rig pa za bar byed pa ste pa ra ni pha rol/ bi ṣa ni rig pa/ bhak+ṣa ṇa ni za ba'o/ /sarba duṣ+ta na pra duṣ+tā ṇaṃ stam+bha na ka rī ni gdug pa dang rab tu gdug pa can thams cad rengs par byed pa ste/ sarba ni thams cad/ duṣ+ta na gdug pa/ pra ni rab tu/ duṣ+tā ṇaṃ ni gdug pa can/ stam+bha na ni rengs pa ste lus g.yo 'gul byed mi nus 。pa'o/ /sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa gra hā naṃ bi dh+waṃ sa na ka ri ni gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gdon thams cad 'jig par byed pa ste/ yak+ṣa gnod sbyin/ rāk+ṣa sa srin po/ grwa hā naṃ gdon/ bi dh+waṃ sa ni 'jig pa'o/ /sarba ba ra bid+yā ts+tshe da na ka rī ni gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa ste/ pa ra ni gzhan nam pha rol/ bid+yā ni rig sngags/ ts+tshe da ni gcod pa'o/ /tsa tur shī ti nāṃ gra ha sa ha sra ṇāṃ bi dh+waṃ sa na ka rī ni gdon stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'jig par byed pa ste/ tsa tu ra ni bzhi/ shi ti naṃ ni brgyad cu/

gra ha ni gdon/ sa ha sra ṇāṃ ni stong phrag go /aṣ+ta biṃ sha tī nāṃ nak+ṣa trā ṇāṃ pra sā da na ka rī ni rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' bar byed pa ste/ aṣ+ta ni brgyad/ biṃ sha tī nāṃ ni nyi shu/ nak+ṣa trā ṇāṃ ni rgyu skar/ pra sā da na ni dga' ba'o/ /aṣ+tā naṃ ma hā gra hā ṇāṃ bi dh+waṃ sa na ka rī ni gza' chen po brgyad 'jig par byed pa ste/ aṣ+tā brgyad/ ma hā chen po/ gra hā ṇāṃ gdon dang za bar byed pa la 'jug kyang 'dir gza'/ bi dh+waṃ sa na ka ṝ ni 'jig par byed pa'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ hrīḥṣ+toṃḥbazhi ni rim pa bzhin dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du byed pa'o slob dpon shu rāṅga badz+ras 'chad cing*/ kha cig lha'i sa bon du bshad de brtag sngags de dag gang gi yin pa ni/ rgya 'grel de las gtso mo dang*/ rtsibs kyi lha mo brgyad dang*/ sgo bzh-i lha mo bzhi ste bcu gsum gyi sngags su byas nas/ grwa'i lha mo bzhi'i sngags ni rtsibs mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi dang 'dra bas log su ma bshad ces 'chad la/ rim pa bzhin du 'byung pau'i gdon dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ rgyal po'i chad pa dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gdon dang*/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ rgyu skar dang gza'i gnod pa dang*/ dug dang mtshon dang me chu'i gnod pa dang ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa las sgrol cig ces bskul zhing*/ yi ge bzhis bdud bzhi dang nyon mongs pa bzhi dang sgrib pa bzhi sbyong zhing ye shes bzhi dgug gzhug gi 'phrin las bzhi byed par bshad do/ /rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba satwa nañtsa ni bdag dang sems can thams cad la srungs shig srungs shig ces pa ste/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ni srungs shig māṃ ni bdag sarba satwa nañtsa ni sems can thams cad la zhes pa'o/ /satwa ṣ+tsa dang*/ nañtsa zhes pa zhig 'byung ste 'gal ba mi snang la/ tsa ni dang ram/ kyang zhes pa'i don du sems so/

/gnyis pa la gsum/ gtso mo'i sku'i yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas bde legs su byed pa dang*/ 'khor gyi lha grangs bstan pa dang*/ srung ba'i sngags bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyi gdugs dkar la zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dang zhal gsum phyag drug ma brgyad ma gsum yod kyang*/ 'dir phyag stong can te/ de yang bcom ldan 'das zhes pa nas/ phyir zlog pa chen mo ni sngar ltar la/ de yang sku mdog dkar po/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ /dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ /spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/ sgeg pa dang dpa' ba'i nyams ldan gyi rtsa zhal nyis brgya dkar/ 'jigs su rung ba dang rgod pa'i nyams can gyi g.yas zhal nyis brgya ser/ gshe ba dang rngams pa'i nyams can gyi rgyab zhal nyis brgya dmar/ snying rje dang zhi ba'i nyams ldan gyi g.yon zhal nyis brgya ljang*/ ngo mtshar ba dang drag po'i nyams can gyi steng zhal nyis brgya sngo/ /zhal re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu re re la khro bo'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbu'i steng du gdung bdun dang bde gshegs bcu sogs sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun gyi cod pan 'chang ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon gyi dang pos gdugs dkar po'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi lhag ma dgu bcu rtsa brgyad na 'khor lo dang mda'/ de'i lhag ma g.yas kyi bzhi brgyas rdo rje rin po che pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje rnams brgya phrag re dang*/ g.yon gyi bzhi brgyas gzhu ral gri zhags pa lcags kyu rnams brgya phrag re 'dzin cing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas lnga brgya brgyangs pas rgyal po'i 'jigs pa sogs 'jigs pa chen po thams cad gnon pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon lnga brgya bskums pas mdangs 'phrog pa la sogs pa'i gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa/ sku'i cha thams cad na zur gyis lta ba dang*/ cher bgrad pa dang*/

glog ltar 'gyu ba dang*/ drag tu gzir ba la sogs pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'phro ba/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ de'i 'od kyis sa steng sa 'og sa bla'i sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor 'gengs par mdzad pa'o/ /spyan bye ba brgya stong ni/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum ste spyan stong phrag gsum dang*/ gzhan sku'i cha thams cad na yod pas grangs khyon bsdoms na bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba'o/ /de nyid khrag khrig chen po gcig yin te/ bye ba bcu la dung 'phyur gcig bye ba brgya la ther 'bum gcig bye ba stong la ther 'bum chen po gcig bye ba khri la khrag khrig gcigabye ba 'bum la khrag khrig chen po gcig yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'khor gyi lha mo bcu ni/ shar rtsibs la rnam par bsgyings ma rdo rje sngon po rdo rje dang ut+pal/ lhor gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma ser mo 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ nub tu dkar mo pad+mar rdo rje dang pad+ma'i sdong po/ /byang du rdo rje 'gros ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang ut+pal/ 'dir go rim mi 'dra ba zhig kyang snang*/ byang shar du pad+ma'i spyan dmar mo 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ shar lhor zla ba'i 'od dkar mo rdo rje dang zla ba/ lho nub tu sangs rgyas dpal dmar mo pad+ma dmar po'i steng na rdo rje dang snang mtha'/ de bzhin du nub byang du pad+ma'i spyan ser mo sna tshogs rdo rje dang ut+pal/ shar ngos kyi steng phyogs su rdo rje nyi ma'i 'od dmar mo rdo rje dang nyi ma/ de bzhin du nub ngos kyi steng phyogs su zla ba rdo rje dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon zla ba bsnams pa'o/ /de thams cad kyang rgyan cha lugs rdzogs pa zla ba'i gdan sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rig pa gtso mo dang phyag rgya'i 'khor dang gsang sngags kyi tshig de dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad la srung du gsol zhes gsol te/

oṃ ri ṣi ga ṇa sogs gsungs la/ oṃ ni 'go 'dren/ ṛ ṣi ni drang srong*/ ga ṇa ni tshogs/ pra shāsta ni rab tu bstan pa ste/ pra ni rab/ shāsta ni bstan pa'o/ /sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūṃ drūṃ/ de bzhin du dzam+bha na ka rī/ stam+bha na/ ma hā bid+yā sam+bhak+ṣa ṇa ni rig pa chen mo zad par byed pa/ pa ra bid+yā saṃ bhak+ṣa ṇa ni gzhan gyi rig sngags zad par byed pa/ sarba duṣ+tā nāṃ sogs sngar bzhin no/ /hūṃ drūṃ ni hūṃ gi rdo rjes gcad pa dang*/ drūṃ gis phur bus gdab pa'o zhes bshad/ hūṃ hūṃ ni bskul bar byed pa dang*/ phaṭa phaṭa ni don de gsal bar byed pa'o/ /rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ni srungs shig gnyis dang*/ māṃni bdag la/ swāhā ni gzhi tshugs shig pa'o/ /'di'i dzam+bha na ni rnam par bsgyings pa/ stam+bha na gser 'od lta bu/ ma hā bid+yā sam+bhak+ṣa ṇa rdo rje dkar mo/ pa ra bid+yā rdo rje 'gros/ sarba duṣ+tā naṃ pad+ma'i spyan/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa zla 'od/ tsa tur shī tī sangs rgyas dpal/ aṣ+tā biṃ shā tī spyan/ aṣ+tā naṃ ma hā gra ha ni nyi 'od dang zla ba rdo rje 'dzin gnyis ky-i sngags so/ /gnyis pa mi shis pa sbyang ba la gsum/ lha'i yon tan brjod nas 'jigs pa dang gdon las bde legs su bya ba/ za ba po'i gdon rnams las srung bar byed pa/ gzhan gyi rig sngags gcad cing phur bus gdab pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'jigs pa dang*/ gdon las bde legs su bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ lha'i yon tan brjod pa dang*/ 'jigs pa rnams smos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor zhes pa nas/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ /rdo rje yangs pa chen po zhes pa'i bar te don ni sngar ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das ma des sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du bdag dang sems can thams cad/ sdig spyod kyi rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang*/ de bzhin du rkun po dang*/

me chu dang*/ dug rigs dang*/ mtshon cha'i rigs dang*/ pha rol gyi dgra'i dmag tshogs dang*/ mu ge dang*/ rang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra dang*/ thogs sam lce 'bab pa dang*/ tshe ma zad par dus min du 'chi ba ste 'di la me chu sogs kyis 'chi ba sogs dgu dang gzhan yang grangs med pa zhig yod par bshad/ sa g.yo ba ni sa 'gul ba ste 'di la chu rlung 'khrugs pa'i rkyen dang*/ klu chen po 'ga' zhig rgya mtsho nas phyir 'byung ba dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi cho 'phrul dang*/ 'khrugs pa chen po yong ba'i snga ltas su sa 'gul 'byung bar bshad cing spyi mthun gyi las kyi mthus g.yo ba sogs mang ngo*/ /skar mda' lhung ba ni 'dod lha'i gzhal med khang las me'i rnam pa mched cing 'byung ba'o/ /rgyal po'i khrims kyi chad pa dang*/ lha dang klu'i 'jigs pa dang*/ glog ni char drag po 'bab pa'i dus su tsha reg gi 'od 'khyug pa ste/ gzhung kha cig tu thog la bshad/ nam mkha' lding ni khyung ste 'di phyi'i rgya mtsho dang nye ba na mang du yod par bshad cing*/ 'jig rten pa'i khyung kun gyi rgyal po ni nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig 'khyil ba'o/ /gcan gzan khro bo ni gcan gzan ma rungs pa stag seng la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa'o/ /gnyis pa gdon so sor smos nas de dag las srung du gsol ba ni/ de la lha ni tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang nyi zla la sogs pa'o/ /gdon ni de dag gi 'khor gyi rigs rnams kyi gnod pas 'dzin pa ste grwa hā ni 'dzin pa la'ang 'gro bas so/ /klu ni klu chen brgyad dang de'i 'khor gyi rigs so/ /dri za ni rgyal po yul 'khor srung gi 'khor na yod cing lha'i pi wang mkhan dang zas su dri za ba zhig go /mi'am ci ni dud 'gro'i rigs mi dang byad dbyibs dra ba zhig ste/ kha cig 'di ni lus mi la rta'i gdong pa can du yod par bshad/ lto 'phye chen po ni sa bdag lto 'phye chen po lta bu ste sbrul gyi gzugs can du bshad/

gnod sbyin ni byang phyogs lcang lo can na gnas shing gzhan la gnod cing mchod sbyin len pa'o/ /srin po ni gtso bor lho nub na gnas shing mi'i sha khrag sogs za ba la dga' ba 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs can no/ /yi dwags ni bkrais shing skom nas bza' btung yid la btags pa dang de min pa gzhan yang mang ngo*/ /sha za ni lus shin tu phra ba zhig ste mi sha rjen par za ba la dga' ba'o/ /'byung po ni byang shar na gnas shing ri rab kyi steng sogs na'ang yod de/ cha gsum gyi gzhung las/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*/ /zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar rnam grangs shin tu mang ngo*/ /srul po ni lus gos hrul ba zhig dang*/ cha gsum ṭīkar/ lus srul po ni lus dri nga ba sogs dang re lde gon pa'i yi dwags kyi bye brag go zhes 'byung ba ltar dang*/ skem byed ni gzhon nu gdong drug ste des lha ma yin gyi stobs skem par byed pa'o/ /brjed byed ni gzhan gyi dran pa nyams shing rgyal bar byed pa zhig dang*/ smyo byed ni gzhan gyi yid dran med du smyo bar byed pa zhig go /grib gnon ni grib mas gzhan gnon cing gnod par byed pa'o/ /gnod po ni gzhan nyal pa la brang nas gnod cing gnod par byed pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni rig sngags grub nas nam mkha' sogs la 'gro ba'o/ /nam gru ni lha mo re ma ti 'khor bcas dang*/ gshin rje ni lho phyogs na gnas shing gshin po dang yi dwags kyi rjer gyur pa'o/ /bya ni byis pa'i gdon bya'i gzugs can zhig dang*/ ma mo dga' bar byed pa ni ma mo brgyad po dga' bar byed pa'o/ /'dir kha cig kun tu 'gro ba ni ma dag ste/ kun tu gre ba dang kun tu 'cha' ba'o zhes dang*/ tsher ma 'don pa yang ma dag ste/ tsher ma dor ba'am 'dod pa'o zhes zer te brtag /gdon zhes pa ni len pa'am 'dzin pa'i don te gdon gyi skad dod gra hā ni nye bar len pa dang 'dzin pa gnyis ka la 'jug pa'i phyir ro/

/sngar smos pa'i 'jigs pa dang gdon de las bdag srung zhing bde legs su gyur cig ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ zas su mdangs za ba sogs te/ de yang 'dir slob dpon shu rāṅga badz+ra gyi rgya gzhung ltar na/ zas su mdangs za ba lha/ mngal za ba klu/ khrag thung ba lha min/ zhag za ba gnod sbyin/ sha za ba srin po/ tshil za ba yi dwags/ rkang za ba sha za/ btsas pa za ba 'byung po/ srog 'phrog pa grul bum/ skyugs pa za ba srul po/ phyi sa za ba lus srul po/ gcin 'thung ba skyem byed/ stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba brjed byed/ lhag ma za ba smyo byed/ snabs za ba grib gnon/ ngar snabs za ba gnon po/ mi gtsang ba za ba mkha' 'gro ma/ gtor ma za ba nam gru/ phreng ba za ba gshin rje/ dri za ba bya'i gdon/ me tog za ba ma mo dga' bar byed pa/ 'bras bu dang lo tog za ba kun tu 'gro/ sbyin sreg za ba tsher ma 'don pa dang sbyar ro/ /tsan+da go mi'i gzhung du grags pa'i gtor chog zhig las/ mngal za ba brgya byin/ khrag thung ba mkha' 'gro ma/ zhag za ba ma mo/ sha za ba gshin rje/ tshil za ba gza'/ rkang za ba srin po/ btsas pa za ba mkha' lding*/ srog 'phrog pa yul 'khor srung*/ skyugs pa za ba mig mi bzang*/ gcin 'thung ba ming po dang sring mo/ stor khung 'thung ba chu lha/ lhag ma za ba srin mo/ mchil ma 'thung ba klu/ snabs za ba sa bdag ngar snabs za ba mi'am ci/ mi gtsang ba za ba 'byung po/ /gtor ma za ba gnod sbyin/ phreng ba za ba tshangs pa/ dri za ba lto 'phye/ gdug pa za ba rnam sras/ me tog za ba lha chen/ 'bras bu za ba 'phags skyes po/ /lo tog za ba rlung lha/ sbyin bsreg za ba me lha ste/ de dag 'khor dang bcas par bshad cing*/ mdangs za ba dang*/ phyi sa za ba sems 'phrog pa la bshad pa mi snang*/ bod kyi gdugs dkar gyi bzlog chen 'ga' zhig las/ phreng ba za ba tshangs gdon/ dri za ba yul 'khor srung*/ 'bras bu za ba 'phags skyes po/ skyugs pa za ba mig mi bzang*/

gdug pa za ba rnam thos sras/ mngal za ba rgya byin/ sbyin bsreg za me lha/ sha za gshin rje/ rkang za srin po/ me tog za dbang phyug mchil 'thung klu/ lo tog za rlung lha/ gtor ma za gnod sbyin/ mi gtsang za 'byung po/ tshil za gza'/ snabs za sa bdagarnag za lha min/ ngar snabs za mi'am ci/ zhag za ma mo/ khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro ma/ btsas za mkha' lding*/ gcin 'thung sring mo bzhi/ lhag ma za ba srin mo/ dri za ba lto 'phye dang sbyar zhing go rims snga ma dang mi 'dra yang don phal cher 'dra'o/ /'di dag gi sgras zin gyi don ltar za rgyu la/ zas su mdangs za ba ni mdangs ni gzi mdangs/ mngal ni sha ma lta bu/ khrag ni khrag sna/ zhag ni sha tshil btsos pa'i zhag sha ni sha rjen/ tshil ni sha tshil/ rkang mar ni rus pa'i nang gi rkang*/ btsas pa ni sems can btsas pa'i khyad par zhig la sbyar dgos pa ltar snang yang*/ bu ram dang shing kun sbyar ba la yang bshad/ tshe srog 'phrog pa ste gcod pa/ skyugs pa ni kha nas skyugs pa'i zas chu/ phyi sa ni dri chen/ gcin ni dri chu/ stor khung ni dgon grong gi chu 'bab pa'i khung bu/ kha'i mchil ma/ sna'i snabs/ kha lud kyi ngar snabs/ kha zas mi gtsang ba/ glud kyi gtor ma/ bo ti tsi sogs kyi phreng ba/ tsan+dan sogs kyi dri/ sbyar ba'i spos/ mar gyi sbyin sregasnying rlung sogs kyis sems 'khrugs pa dang*/ me tog sna tshogs dang*/ shing tog gi 'bras bu dang*/ lo tog sna tshogs so/ /'di dag gi dod du mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig bshad pa ni/ mngal dang srog 'phrog pa zhes pa la mngar gsum/ sems 'phrog pa la rgun chang*/ skyugs pa la sman dang sbrang rtsi/ phyi sa la tsam pa/ gcin la chang*/ stor khung nas 'bab pa la chu sna sna tshogs/ mchil ma la sbrang rtsi/ snabs la bya mo'i sgo nga*/ ngar snabs la bya pho'i sgo nga*/ mi gtsang ba la sgog gtsong*/ gtor ma la 'khur ba rnams bshad cing*/ mi 'dra ba gzhan yang yod la/ phreng ba dang dri dang bdug pa dang sbyin sreg dang me tog dang 'bras bu dang lo tog rnam sngar dang 'dra'o/

/de dag ni 'dir rnam grangs shes pa'i ched tsam du bkod do/ /gsum pa ni/ gong du brjod pa'i gdon de dag thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab po/ gcad pa dang*/ phur bus gdab pa ni/ shu rāṅga badz+ras/ gdon de dag thams cad kyi gzugs dang rig sngags rnams liṅga la mtshon gyis btab nas gcad cing*/ liṅga la phur bus btab nas mnan pa bya'o zhes bshad la/ don du de dag gi rig sngags kyi nus pas rang la mi tshugs par mdzad pa la de gcad pa dang*/ rig sngags kyis bya ba sgrub mi nus shing g.yo 'gul med par mdzad pa la phur bus gdab par bzhag kyang chog snyam mo/ /lots+tsha blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur las/ rig sngags rig pa'i ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje'i phur bus gdab po zhes kyang 'byung ngo*/ /gcad do zhes gas 'phus mdzad pa ni gcad par bya ba'i don yin gyi/ bcad zin pa'i don min pa'o/ /kun tu rgyu ni phyi rol pa'i rnal 'byor ba dang de'i rigs zhig ste/ mdo sde sogs las shes so/ /mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma ni u rgyan yul na mang zhing rig sngags grub pa ste phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro pho mo gnyis so/ /sngar bshad pa'i tshangs pa dang*/ lha dbang phyug chen po dang*/ sred med kyi bu dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po 'khor dang lhan cig pa dang*/ sngar gyi legs ldan nag po chen po dang*/ tshangs ma dang*/ dpa' mo dang*/ khyab 'jug ma dang*/ phag mo dang*/ gzhon nu ma sogs ma mo rnams dang*/ mi mgo'i thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa dang*/ rgyal bar byed pa dang*/ sbrang rtsir byed pa dang*/ don kun grub pa ste ming po gsum dang*/ dga' ba mo dang*/ gsod pa mo dang*/ grub pa mo dang*/ zhib mo ste sring mo bzhi ste mi 'dra ba zhig kyang bshad/ dbang phyug gi 'khor bh+ring gi ri ti dang*/ dga' byed dbang phyug dang*/ de'i bu tshogs kyi bdag po 'khor dang lhan cig pa ste 'di dag ni lha chen yin no/

/dge sbyong gcer bu ni phyi rol pa'i dge sbyong gos med par rgyu ba ste gcer bu pa'o/ /dge sbyong mgo reg ni skra ring por bzhag pa'i dge sbyong zhig la bshad pa dang*/ ral pa skra brag pa'i dge sbyong la bshad pa gnyis so/ /dgra bcom pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba'i phyir mi 'ong ba dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs dang*/ lag na rdo rje ni phyag na rdo rje ste rgyud kyi skor na 'di gnyis kyi dbang du mdzad pa'i las tshogs mang po 'byung ba'i nang tshan drag po'i rig sngags la dgongs pa gsal la/ de yang 'di rnams kyi sgo nas rang gzhan la gnod pa'i rig sngags kyi nus pa yang gcod nus na gzhan lta ci smos zhes gzungs 'di'i che ba brjod pa'o/ /kha cig de gnyis spyan ras gzigs dang phyag rdor dngos min te/ rje'i zhal nas/ gang gi sgo nas mi bsrun skye bo yis/ /zhes sogs gsungs zhes lung 'dren par nang yang ma nges te/ de ltar yin na dgra bcom pa dang phyir mi 'ong ba yang de gnyis dngos ma yin par thal ba'i phyir te/ de dag mi bsrun pa'i skye bo ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na de gnyis dngos min par bshad pa dang 'gal lo/ /des na mi bsrun skya bo ni lha de dag gi sngags sbyor la brten nas rang gzhan la gnod pa'i sbyor ba byed pa la dgongs kyi/ sngags kyi lha de dag mi bsrun ba yin mi dgos te/ dgos na/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum la sogs kyi rgyud nas pha rol la drag po'i las sbyor mang du gsungs pas yi dam gyi lha de rnams kyang mi bsrun pa nyid du thal bar 'gyur ro/ /spyir pho nya ni/ bang tshan dang*/ bran ni g.yog 'khor yin par bshad cing*/ rnam grangs mang la/ 'dir rgya 'grel las pho nya phyogs skyong la bshad cing*/ kha cig pho nya pad+ma 'dzin/ kun tu snang ba/ rdo rje sde dpon/ bran dga' ba'i dpal/ 'bar ba'i gzi brjid/ rdo rje dga' byed rnams la bshad/

de dag la pho mo gnyis su dbye'o/ /lha mi'i drang srong gi tshogs dang*/ lha'i tshogs dang*/ mi 'phrod pa za ba ni zas mi mthun pa sna tshogs za ba'i bdag po ste/ de rnams kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab po zhes pa'o/ /'di dag gi skor la bshad tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' re snang ngo*/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ snying po dang*/ thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags so/ /dang po ni/ shu rāṅga badz+ra gyis skabs 'dir gdugs dkar zhal lnga phyag brgyad ma bsgom par bshad cing*/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i bar dang*/ srung du gsol zhes pa'i bar ni sngar ltar ro/ /sngags kyi don ni/ oṃ ni 'go 'dren/ a si ta nas ta pa tre'i bar la don cung zad mi 'dra ba gsum ste/ mi thub pa'i nyi ma'i 'odazer 'phro ba'i gdugs dkar po can zhes dang*/ shin tu tsha ba'i me dang nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phro zhing rgyas pa'i ched du skyob pa dkar po can zhes dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis kha phye ba'i gdugs dkar po can zhes pa gsum 'byung zhing*/ kho bo ltar na/ a si ta ni shin tu tsha ba/ a na le ni me/ arka ni nyi ma/ pra bhā ni 'od/ s+phu ṭa ni 'phro ba/ bi ka ni rgyas pa/ si ta ni dkar po/ ta pa tre ni gdugs so/ /zhes bya'o/ /oṃ ni dpal/ dz+wa la dz+wa la ni 'bar bar gyis shig gnyis/ khā da khā da ni zo zo/ ha na ha na bsnun bsnun/ da ha da ha sregs sregs/ da ra ni 'joms shig bi da ra ni rab tu bshig pa'am rnam par 'joms shig pa'o/ /kha cig dha ra dha ra/ bidha ra bidha ra zhes byas nas zungs dang rab tu zungs shig la bsgyur kyang snga ma legs so/ /tshin+da ni chod cig bin+da ni phug cig ces pa'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ ni bskul ba/ phaṭa phaṭa ni gsal ba/ swāhā ni gzhi tshugs pa'o/ /de dag don dang sbyar na/ dz+wa la ni rdo rje 'bar ba/ khā da ni ral gris gcod cing za ba/ ha na ni gtun shing gis bsnun pa/

da ra ni 'khor lo 'chang ba'am des 'joms pa/ bi da ra ni lcags kyus 'dzin pa'am 'joms pa/ ts+tshin+da ni dgra stas gcod pa/ bin+da ni mdung gis phug pa'o zhes bshad de/ de dag ni snying po'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ he he phaṭa ni kye kye/ ho ho phaṭa ni mnyes par byed pa gnyis/ a mo gha ya ni don yod pa/ a pra ti ha tā ya ni thogs pa med pa ste a ni med pa/ pra ti ha ta ni thogs pa'o/ /kha cig so sor 'brang ba zhes bsgyur ba ni don min no/ /ba ra dā ya ni mchog tu sbyin ma'am stsol ma/ kha cig dha ra zhes byas nas 'dzin par bsgyur yang snga ma bde'o/ /pa ra pra dā ya ni mchog rab tu sbyin ma ste bar ni mchog pra ti ni rab/ dā ya ni sbyin ma'o/ /kha cig dha rar byas nas 'dzin par bsgyur yang mi bde/ pra t+ya d+gir tā ni phyir zlog pa/ a su ra ni lha ma yin nam chang med de/ de yang su ra ni chang*/ a ni dgag tshig tu byas nas chang med de lha ma yin du bsgyur ro/ /bi drwā ba ṇa ni rnam par 'tshe ba ste/ bi ni rnam par/ drā ba ṇa ni 'tshe ba/ ka rā ni byed pa'o/ /ba ra bi drwā ba ṇa sogs ni gzhan gyis rnam par 'tshe bar byed pa ste/ ba ra ni gzhan/ bi drā pa ṇa sogs sngar ltar ro/ /ya rnams ni rnam dbye bzhi pa ste la zhes pa'i don shu rāṅga badz+ra gyis/ he he nas 'di'i bar gyi rnam par bsgyings ma nas zla ba rdo rje 'dzin gyi bar gyi lha mo rnams gtso mo'i dbu nas mig g.yon par bsgom pa dang*/ shar sogs la in+d+ra ye phaṭa sogs kyis dbang po la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad dang*/ gshin rje ma bzhi dang*/ zhing skyong bskor bshad do/ /de nas/ sarba de be bh+yaḥphaṭa/ lha thams cad la zhes pa ste/ sarba ni thams cad/ de be ni lha/ bh+yaḥni la ste ched du zhes pa rnam dbye bzhi pa yin te/ kun rig cha gsum gyi ṭīkar/ pri thi wi bh+yaḥni 'og gi sa lha'i ched du/ a su ra bh+yaḥni lha ma yin gyi ched du/

nā ge bh+yaḥni klu'i ched du zhes pa'o zhes 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de bzhin du nā ge klu/ rak+ṣa se srin po/ bhū te 'byung po/ pre te yi dwags/ bi shā tse sha za/ kuṣ+man+de grul bum/ pū ta ni srul po/ ka ṭa ne pū ta ni lus srul po/ skan+dhe skem byed/ un+mā de smyo byed/ ts+tshā ye grib gnon/ a pa smā re brjed byed/ ostā ra ge gnon po/ ḍā ki ni mkha' 'gro /re ba ti nam gru/ ya ma ye gshin rje/ sha ku ni bya/ mā tri nan+di ke'am/ mā tri ga ṇa ni ma mo'i tshogs te/ ma tri ma mo/ ga ṇa tshogs so/ /kam+bu ke ma ni kun tu 'go ba'am gre ba/ a ba laṃ bha ke ni re lde 'don pa/ ka ṭa ṭa ni tsher ma 'dor ba'am 'don pa/ gan+dha rbe ni dri za mo/ a su ra lha min/ kin+na re mi'am ci/ ga ru ḍe mkha' lding*/ ma ho ra ge lto 'phye chen po ste/ de'i ma hā chen po/ ur lto ba/ ge 'phye ba ste/ ma ho na hī'i srog gi ā u la or song ba'o/ /yak+ṣa gnod sbyin/ dur laṃ gi te sgom nyes sam srin po/ duṣ+p+ra te lta nyes sam yi dwags/ dz+wa re rims/ bha ye 'jigs pa/ u pa dra be nye bar 'tshe ba ste u pa nye bar/ dra be 'tshe ba'o/ /u pa sarge nye bar bsgyur ba ste/ snga ma la srul po dang*/ 'di la lus srul por bsgyur ba'ang snang ste brtagakṛt+ya karma ṇi byed kyi las/ ka kho rde bya ba/ ki ra ṇa g.yang byed pa/ bai tā ṭa ro langs ma'am ro langs kyi rtsod pa/ tsats+tshe pra sha ka sems bsgyur ba/ duṣ+tsa rdi te skyugs nyes/ dur+bhuk+te bza' nyes/ tir+thi ke mu stegs byed/ shra ma ṇe dge sbyong*/ pā ta ke mgo reg dang ltung byed du bsgyur ba gnyis/ bid+yā dha re rig 'dzin ma/ dza ya ka ra rgyal bar byed pa/ ma dhu ka ra sbrang rtsir byed pa/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ke bh+yo ni don kun grub par byed pa rnams te/ sarba ni kun/ ar+tha ni don/ sā dha ke bh+yo ni grub par byed pa rnams so/

/bid+yā rig sngags/ tsar+ya spyod pa/ tsa tur+bh+yo bha gi ni sring mo bzhi ste tsa tur bzhi/ bh+yo bha gi ni sring mo/ badz+ra ku ma ri rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ badz+ra kū lan+dha ri rdo rje rig 'dzin ma ste/ ku ma ri gzhon nu/ kū la rigadha ri 'dzin pa'o/ /bid+yā tsar+ye rig pa spyod pa/ ma hā pra t+yaṅgi re phyir zlog pa chen mo/ /'di yan bh+yaḥphaṭa sbyar ba zhe drug go /badz+ra sha ka lā ya rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ pra t+yaṅgi ra rā dza ya ni phyir zlog pa'i rgyal po/ ma hā kā lā la ma tri ga ṇa na maḥkṛ tā ya ni nag po chen po ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa ste/ ma hā kā lā nag po chen/ ma tri ga ṇa ma mo'i tshogs/ na maḥkṛ ta ni phyag byas pa/ ya ni la ste rnam dbye bzhi pa'o/ /de nas prah+ma ṇī tshangs ma/ biṣ+tu bi ye khyab 'jug ma/ ma he shwa re ye dbang phyug chen mo ste/ u ma la go dgos shing*/ i shwa re dbang phyug gi ming yin la/ ma ha'i srog gi ā dang i las er song nas mtshams sbyar bas ma he'o/ /ru tri ye drag mo/ ma hā kā lā+e ye nag mo chen mo/ tsa muṇ+ḍī ye gtum ma'i rgan byed ma/ ku ma ri ye gzhon nu ma/ wa rā hi ye phag mo/ in+d+ra ye dbang mo/ ag+nī ye me lha mo/ ya ma ye gshin rje mo/ nai ṛ ti ye bden bral ma/ wa ru ṇa ye chu lha mo/ ma ru ti ye rlung lha mo/ sau ma ye zla ba mo/ i sha nī ye dbang ldan ma/ kā la dan+ḍi ye dus kyi dbyug pa ste kā la dus/ daṇ+ḍi dbyug kā la rā tri ye dus mtshan ma/ ya ma daṇ+ḍi ye gshin rje'i dbyug pa/ ra tri ye ni drag mo/ ka pā li ye thod pa can ma/ a dhi muk+ti sha ma sha na ba si ni ye ni dur khrod na gnas par mos pa ste/ sh+ma sha na ni dur khrod kyi ming ngo*/ /'di dur khrod kyi mnga' bdag mor bsgyur ba'ang snang ngo*/ /ban+dha ban+dha/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ ni 'ching 'ching*/ srungs srungs bdag la'o/ /ṣ+toṃḥni lha'i sa bon du mngon/

gong gi bh+yaḥphaṭa yod pa de rnams ni gtor ma sogs kyis mchod pa dang*/ badz+ra shaṃ kā la ya ma na ched bod pa'am bskul ba'i sngags su bshad do/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ ngan sems can lnga byams pa dang ldan pas srung du gsol ba/ gdon sna tshogs las srung du gsol ba/ nad sna tshogs las srung du gsol ba/ gnod pa sna tshogs las srung du gsol ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sems can gang su dag bdag la zhes pa nas/ ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig gi bar te/ gdug pa dang drag shul dang sdig pa dang 'khrugs pa dang sdang ba rnams la gnyis re 'byung ba'i snga ma gdug sems sogs dang ldan pa'i gang zag gi lus ngag gi bya ba dang*/ phyi ma ni de dag gi bsam pa'i khyad par ro/ /'di lnga'i khyad par dbye dka' yang*/ gdug sems ni dngos su gnod par mi sems kyang sems de mi gtong ba'o/ /drag shul ni lus ngag gi sbyor ba rtsub cing drag po byed par 'dod pa'o/ /sdig sems ni lus srog la dngos su gnod par sems pa'o/ /'khrugs pa ni dngos su gnod par mi sems kyang sems khong nas 'khrugs pa'o/ /sdang ba ni dngos sam brgyud nas zhe sdang ba ste gang zag gcig la thams cad 'byung ba mi 'gal lo/ /de dag thams cad byams pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la srung du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho ba ni lo brgya thub pa'o/ /ston brgya mthong ba ni lo brgya la ston gyi dus brgya yod la/ ston dus su 'bras bu smin pa sogs longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i dus yin pas bzang ba la dgongs sam snyam/ gnyis pa ni/ gnod sbyin dang gdon gang su dag zhes sogs te/ 'di la gnyis kyi dang po zas kyi dbang du byas na/ zas su mdangs za ba sogs nyer brgyad dang*/ lha'i gdon la sogs pa nyer bzhi rnams las srung du gsol lo zhes pa ste/ zas skor sngon ma la gzi byin 'phrog pa zhes pa mi snang bas nyer bdun dang*/ 'dir de yod pas nyer brgyad do/

/gdon gyi skor snga ma la nyer brgyad dang*/ 'dir rlung lha dang nam mkha' lding dang dri za dang mi'am ci dang grub bum dang lto 'phye chen po drug med kyang*/ kusman+de dang re lde 'don pa'i gdon gnyis yod pas nyer bzhi'o/ /de rnams snga ma dang go rim mi 'dra yang don ni sngar bshad pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ rims nad zhi bar gsol ba dang*/ nad sna tshogs zhi bar gsol ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang zhes sogs te/ spyir rims la rlung mkhris bad kan dang gdon las gyur pa'i rims nad mang du bshad cing*/ ma mo mkha' 'gro khros na rims nad sna tshogs gtong bar bshad/ rims gcig pa sha'i rtsa bar gnas shing nyin re lan re ldang ba dang*/ nyin gnyis pa gsal bar ma bshad kyang nyi ma gnyis la 'byung ba'am gnas pa zhig dang*/ nyin gsum pa tshil gyi rtsa la gnas shing nyi ma gsum re dang*/ nyin bzhi pa tshil dang rkang dang rus la gnas shing nyi ma bzhi re dang*/ nyin bdun pa ni rlung mkhris bad kan las byung ste nyi ma bdun dang de las lhag kyang gnas so/ /de dag ni rang gnas pa'i nyi ma'i grangs kyi sgo nas ming btags par snang ste der ma nges par sems so/ /rtag pa'i rims ni gtso bor khrag la brten cinganyin mtshan du lan gnyis re ldang bar bshad/ /rims mi bzad pa ni 'dus pa'i nad kyi rigs dmod pa las byung zhing nad tshabs che ba zhig go /'byung po'i rims ni gdon gyis bskyed pa'i rims so/ /rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan dang 'dus pa las gyur pa'i rims ni de dag las byung ba'o/ /spyir mi'i lus la rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa bzhi yod kyang 'byung ba cha mnyam pa'i tshe de dag gi nad mi ldang la/ 'byung ba phan tshun mi 'phrod par gyur pa na nad bskyed do/ /rlung mkhris sogs de dag tsha grang gang du gtogs pa ni/ ji skad du/ khrag dang mkhris pa tsha bar 'dus/ /rlung dang bad kan grang bar 'dus/

/zhes 'byung ba ltar dang*/ de dag gi nad ldang ba'i dus ni/ gser 'od las/ rlung kha shas che'i nad ni dbyar nas ldang*/ /ston du gyur pa na ni mkhris pa g.yo/ /dgun gyi dus su de bzhin 'dus pa ste/ /bad kan shas che'i nad ni dpyid ldang ngo*/ /zhes dang*/ gso tshul yang*/ de nyid las/ rlung gi bdag nyid la ni bcud kyis gso/ /bkru sman gyis ni mkhris pa bsam par bya/ /'dus pa la ni gsum dang thun ldan pa/ bad kan tshigs su babs na skyugs sman btang*/ zhes 'byung ba ltar te/ 'dus pa ni rlung mkhris bad kan gsum chogs pa zhig ste mtshon tsam mo/ /rims nad thams cad dang zhes pas 'go ba'i rims nad gzhan kun bsdus nas bstan to/ /gnyis pa ni/ klad pa na ba ni klad gzer lta bu'o/ /gzhogs phyed na ba ni rtsa rgyus la skyon byung ba sogs kyis lus kyi gzhogs g.yas g.yon gang rung na ba'o/ /yi ga 'chus pa ni dang kha 'gags nas zas mi 'gro ba'o/ /mig nad dang sna nad dang kha nad dang rna ba na ba dang so rnams ni rang ming gis brjod pa ltar dang*/ mgul nad ni mgrin pa'i phyi nang gi nad dang*/ lkog ma'i lha gor yang mgrin pa'i phyogs kyi nad do/ /snying na ba la gnyis byung ba'i snga ma snying dang*/ phyi ma so rnyil na ba'o/ klad pa na ba la'ang gnyis byung ba'i snga ma rims kyi phyogs dang*/ phyi ma spyir bshad dam snyam mo/ /rtsib logs dang rgyab dang lto ba dang rked pa dang brla dang rje ngar dang lag pa dang rkang mgo rnams rang ming gis brjod pa bzhin dang*/ bde mchog gi skor las/ 'bras bu gnyis la chu sor bsgyur ba ltar na/ chu so ni rlig 'bras so/ /kha cig pho mo'i mtshan mar bshad/ yan lag ni yan lag lnga thun mong du brjod pa dang*/ nying lag ni sor mo la sogs pa rnams so/ /bzhi pa ni/ gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo 'dis/ rgya cher rol pa dang 'dul ba nas tshig mi 'dra ba re 'byung yang don 'dra zhing*/

mdzod las/ sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru/ /khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo*/ /de dag lnga brgya rnams la ni/ /rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod/ /de brgyad dpag tshad ces bya'o/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ gzhu 'dom lnga brgya la rgyang grags gcig dang*/ rgyang grags brgyad longs pa'i tshad la dpag tshad gcig bya'o/ /dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad du 'byung po dang*/ mi shi ba la gdon zhugs pa'i ro langs dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ rims dang*/ shu ba ni pags pa'i nad chu ser dang rnag sogs 'dzag pa'o/ /g.ya' ba yang pags pa'i nad do/ /'brum bu phra mo ni 'brum bu thor bu'o/ /mtshan bar rdol ba ni mo mtshan gyi nang du bshad/ mdze ni klu las byung ba chu ser rma dang bcas pa'o/ /phol mig ni rma'i khyad par zhi bcos mi rung ba zhig go /bas ldags kyang rma zhig go /me dpal ni pags nad me ltar tsha ba'o/ /g.yan pa ni pags pa'i nad rnag khrag 'dzag pa zhig go /lhogs pa ni gnyan gyi rigs las byung zhing de la dkar nag khra gsum mo/ /skem pa ni skom nad/ skrag pa ni 'jigs pa'i rnam grangs/ lud pa lu ba ni glo ba'i nad las byung ba'o/ /dbugs mi bde ba ni de'i rkyen gyi dbugs 'byin dka' ba'o/ /mi dran pa ni gdon sogs kyi dbang gis dran pa nyams pa'o/ /dbyig dug ni gser dngul sogs rin po che las byung ba'i dug go /dug sbyar ma ni rdo rtsi sogs rdzas gzhan sbyar ba las byung ba'o/ /dug dngos la klu dang sprul gyi dug dang*/ btsan dug /bong ba nag po/ ra dug /thang khrom sogs mang ngo*/ /gzhan gyi byad kha dang*/ me dang chu dang*/ yams nad kyi mi ngas dang*/ bdud dang dgra'i gnod pa dang*/ gnod pa'i rigs gzhan dang*/ tshe ma zad par du ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ sbrang bu tre ma bu ga ni sbrang bu'i bye brag zhig dang*/ trai la ta ni 'khy-il shig za ba'o zhes zer/ sdig pa ra tsa dang*/ sbrul dang*/

sre mong ni ne'u ser po sre mong zhes 'byung ba de'am snyam ste dpyad/ seṅge dang stag dang dom dang dred ni yongs grags ltar dang*/ g.yag rgod ni kha cig btsan g.yag ri la yan par btang ba la zer yang*/ 'brong ngam/ rgya gar na nags kyi g.yag zhes pa zhig yod par bshad pas de gang rung ngo*/ /chu srin ni rgya mtshor gnas pa ste/ de la sogs pa'i srog chags rnams kyi gnod pa las srung du gsol/ de dag thams cad kyi rig sngags kyi nus pa bcing bar bgyi'o zhes pa'i de dag zhes pa de gong du bshad ma thag pa'i srog chags rnams la byas na mi bde bas/ de'i gong gi gdon de dag la sbyar na legs sam snyam/ gong du bshad pa de rnams kyi gzi brjid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /de las gzhan pa thams cad kyi rig sngags bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams bcing ba ni de dag gis gnod pa'i mtshams bcad pa'o/ /bzhi pa la gnyis/ nye snying bshad pa dang*/ de'i phan yon bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tad+ya thā ni 'di lta ste zhes pa'o/ /oṃ a na le ni me gnyis sam 'bar ba gnyis/ kha sa me mkha' dang mnyam pa gnyis/ bai ra 'jigs pa gnyis/ sau me zla ba/ shān+te zhi ma/ dān+te dul ma/ bi ṣa de dwangs ma/ bī ri dpa' mo/ /de bi badz+ra dha ri lha mo rdo rje 'dzin ma/ ban+dha chings shig badz+ra pā ṇi phyag na rdo rje/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ṣ+toṃḥphaṭa swāhā'i hūṃ gsum ni bskul ba che 'bring chung gsum/ ṣ+toṃḥs bon du mngon/ bdag la srungs shig swāhā ni ma ma rak+ṣa zhes pa bsgyur ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ban+dha ban+dha ni phyag na rdo rje chings chings/ gang gis 'ching na badz+ra pā she na ste rdo rje zhags pas so/ /gang 'ching na ma ma sarba duṣ+taṃ bi na ya kaṃ ste bdag gi gdug pa can log 'dren thams cad chings shig pa'o/ /ma ma bdag sarba duṣ+taṃ gdug pa can thams cad/ bi na ya gaṃ'i na ya 'dren pa/ bi dgag tshig ste don du ma la 'jug kyang 'dir log pa la bsgyur na log 'dren no/

/hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ni bskul ba dang gsal bar byed pa'o/ /de ni nye ba'i snying po'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ lus la bcangs pa dang*/ klogs shing blos bzung ba dang*/ rgyal mtshan btsugs pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po la gsum/ tshe 'di'i phan yon/ 'di phyi gnyis ka'i phan yon/ phyi ma'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ sus de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhes sogs te/ gang zag su zhig gis gdugs dkar mo can gyi nye snying gi srung ba'i 'khor lo 'di/ gro ga'am ras sam shing gi shun pa la bris te zhes gsungs pa'i 'bri tshul la/ shu rāṅga badz+ras 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi lte bar gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ shar du gtum pa chen mo/ lhor 'bar ba chen mo/ nub tu dkar chen 'bar ma/ byang du 'phags ma sgrol ma/ byang shar du rgyal ba'i rdo rje/ shar lhor pad+ma'i mngon mtshan/ lho nub tu 'phreng ba can/ nub byang du rdo rje'i mchu can bri bar bshad la/ yang a na le nas bai ra'i bar brgyad dang sbyar ba'i lha mo brgyad dang*/ dbus su phyag rdor 'bri ba'i 'khor lo zhig bshad cing*/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi nas brgyud pa'i gdugs dkar gyi 'khor lo rgyas bsdus gnyis kyang yod do/ /de lta bu'i 'khor lo de tshul bzhin du bris nas bsgrubs te/ gang gi lus sam zhes pa ni spyir bstan pa'o/ /mgul te mgrin par btags sam/ glegs bam klog par byed na gang zag de ji srid 'tsho ba ste ma shi'i bar du mtshon dang dug dang me dang chu dang dbyig dug dang dug sbyar ma dang byad rnams kyis mi tshugs shing*/ dus ma yin par 'chi bas tshe'i dus byas par mi 'gyur ro/ /gdon thams cad dang bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyang mi de la dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gdon gyi dbye ba ni sngar bshad pa ltar yin la/ gzhan yang cha gsum gyi gzhung las/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma'i skabs su/ shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /zhes sogs kyis phyogs skyong bcu'i 'khor phal cher gdon gyi rigs su bshad cing*/

sde brgyad dang gdon gyi gtor ma'i skabs su/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /zhes sogs dang*/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ gdon rnams rang gi gnas su dengs/ /zhes pas sde brgyad phal cher 'byung po dang bgegs rnams kyang gdon gyi rigs su byas shing*/ man ngag rgyud las/ lha dang lha min dri za klu/ /zhes sogs kyi gdon chen bcwo brgyad bshad pa yang snga ma dang 'dra la/ stod chen las/ byis pa'i gdon chen bcwo lnga yang bshad do/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po dang*/ log 'dren te bgegs kyi rigs thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /kha cig gegs zhes byas nas gnod byed dang*/ log 'dren tshogs bdag la bshad kyang gzhung du bgegs zhes 'byung ba ltar na snga ma bde'o/ /'on kyang bi na ya ka ni bgegs dang log 'dren gnyis ka bsgyur du yod cing*/ tshogs bdag ni bgegs kyi rgyal po yin pas mi 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje'i rigs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ni/ bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad khri bzhi stong yin zhing*/ de la mtha' snang chen po brgyad dang mtha' snang bzhi yod de/ de yang bye ba bcu la dung 'phyur gcig /dung phyur bcu la ther 'bum gcig /de bcu la ther 'bum chen po/ de bcu la khrag khrig /de bcu la khrag khrig chen po/ de bcu la rab bkram/ de bcu la rab bkram chen po/ de bcu la gtam/ de bcu la gtam chen/ de bcu la dkrigs/ de bcu la dkrigs chen po/ de bcu la mi 'khrugs/ de bcu la mi 'khrugs chen po/ de bcu la khyad 'byin/ de bcu la khyad 'byin chen po/ de bcu la lang steng*/ de bcu la lang steng chen po/ de bcu la der 'dren/ de bcu la der 'dren chen po/ de bcu la mtha' snang*/ de bcu la mtha' snang chen po gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /gtam dang dkrigs gnyis gcig tu 'dren pa'i tshul yod kyang*/

'dir so sor byas pa'i lugs so/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyal po ni phyag rdor yin la/ de'i rigs rdo rje'i rigs yin zhing*/ de la ji skad du/ lag na rdo rje mtha' yas pa/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar mang ngo*/ /grub pa'i rigs kyi lha mo ni/ ji skad du/ shed dang yid rjes khyab 'jug dang*/zhes pa nas/ grub pa'i lha ni bcu gnyis grags/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar dang gzhan yang mang*/ rdo rje'i rigs su ma zad/ grub pa'i lha mo de rnams kyis kyang gang zag de la rtag tu mi mthun pa'i phyogs srung ba dang*/ de las skyob pa dang*/ sbed par byed cing*/ lha mo de rnams kyi yid du 'ong ba dang*/ der ma zad dga' bar yang 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa la lnga/ skye ba dran pa/ rdo rje pho nya mos skyong ba/ rigs ngan du mi skye ba/ bsod nams rgya chen po 'grub pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyis srung skyob byed pa'o/ /dang po na/ 'chags bskal/ /gnas bskal/ 'jig bskal/ stong bskal bzhi po re re la bar gyi bskal pa nyi shu re yod pa'i bar bskal brgyad cu longs pa la bskal pa chen po gcig tu byas pa'i bskal pa chen po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ste/ brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar gyi sngon gyi skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ der ma zad/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhis kyang rtag par yongs su skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ dus nam du yang gnod sbyin dang yi dwags dang sha za dang srul po dang lus srul po nyid du skye bar mi 'gyur zhing*/ mi dbul por yang skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan pa ste mnyam pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag ni bsngags brjod yin gyi sgra ji bzhin pa min te/ sangs rgyas gcig gi bsod nams dang mnyam pa thob pa'i sems can mi srid do/

/gaṅgā'i klung ni bla ma kha cig chu bo bzhi'i nang tshan gyi gaṅgā'i chu dang*/ bye ma yang de'i chu'i rdul gyi grangs dang bye ma'i phung po la bzhed pa gnyis dang*/ kha cig chu bo gaṅgā min gyi phyi'i rgya mtsho dang de'i bye ma'o zhes gsungs te gang rung ngo*/ /lnga pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pas gnod pa las srung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ sbed par mdzad cing de dag gi thugs su byon pa ste thugs la 'gro ba dang*/ thugs dgyes par yang 'gyur ro/ /srung skyob sbas gsum gyi don 'chad tshul la cung zad mi 'dra ba re yod kyang*/ thog mar nad dang gdon sogs kyis mi tshugs par mdzad pa ni srung ba yin la/ gal te de dag gi gnod pa byung na de las thar pa'i thabs mdzad pa ni skyob pa dang*/ bsrung bya de dag gnod pa'i gdon sogs kyis mi mthong bar mdzad pa ni sbed pa'i don yin par gsal lo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ blo la bcangs pa'i phan yon dang*/ de dang klog pa gnyis ka'i phan yon bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ skyon bzhi spangs nas yon tan bzhi 'byung ba/ mtshams med lnga byang ba/ las kyi sgrib pa byang ba'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di gang gi blo la 'chang na/ mi dge ba bcus mtshon pa'i tshangs par mi spyod pa'i lam la zhugs pa yang*/ de dag spong ba'i tshangs par spyod pa can du 'gyur ro/ /dgra gdon sogs sngon thub pa ma byas par yang thub par byas par 'gyur ro/ /sgo gsum mi gtsang pa yang gtsang bar 'gyur ro/ /kha zas gcod pa'i smyung ba ma byas pa yang smyung ba byas pa dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ pha dang ma dang dgra bcom pa gsod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku la ngan sems kyi khrag phyung ba dang*/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa ste sngar mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yang byang bar 'gyur

ro/ /ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba ni ngan sems kyis sangs rgyas dngos dkrong mi nus pa shes bzhin du dkrong ba'i sbyor ba byed pa dang*/ de'i dod du da lta sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan khyad par can ngan sems kyis bshig pa'o/ /dge 'dun gyi dbyen ni dge slong phan tshun bzhi bzhi ste brgya yan chad kyi bar du ngan sems kyis phra bcug nas phye ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mdor na tshe rabs sngon mar byas ba'i mi dge ba'i las kyi sgrib pa yang ma lus pa zad par 'gyur ro/ /las sgrib rnams mngon 'gyur ba ci rigs zad pa dang mgo mnon pa la dgongs kyi/ bag chags ma lus bar zad pa ni bdag med mngon sum du rtogs shing goms par byed pa la ltos so/ /yang zhes pa ni sngon ma de tsam du zad ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rigs brgyud rnyed par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyi ma bde ba can du skyes pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ 'di dang phyi ma'i don du chos 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la las/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di blo la 'chang ngam ngag gis klog par byed na/ bu 'dod pa des bu rnyed par 'gyur zhing*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang stobs kyang rab tu rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshe 'di nas shi 'phos kyang nub phyogs bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su pad+ma las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa la lnga ste/ gang gi ched du 'dzugs na/ mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad dang*/ yams kyi nad dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ phan tshun 'khrugs pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad zhi ba'i ched du'o/ /gang 'dzugs na/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i gzugs kyi 'khor lo 'di tshul bzhin du bris nas bsgrubs te bya'o/ /ji ltar 'dzugs na/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la tog gi nang du 'jug pa'am btags te lus ngag gis phyogs dang bkur sti sogs rim gro spyi dang mchod pa chen po byas pa'i tshul gyis so/

/gnas gang du 'dzugs na/ grong khyer thams cad kyi sgo'i steng ngam sgo mdun dang*/ khyim gcig gnyis la sogs pa'i grong dang*/ bzo gnas bcwo brgyad yod pa'i grong khyer chen po dang*/ tshong pa'i rigs mang po gnas pa'i grong rngal dang*/ rgyal rigs sogs rigs bzhi gnas pa'i ljongs zhes bshad pa lta bu dang*/ grong las rgyang grags gcig 'das pa'i dgon pa'i gnas te/ 'am sogs ni 'dam kha can te de rnams gang rung gzugs so/ /btsugs pa'i phan yon ni/ rig sngags kyi rgya la mo'i bsrung 'khor 'di sngar bzhin rim gro cher byas te btsugs na ni/ btsug ma thag tu g.yul bzlog pa'i ched du yin na/ g.yul bshams pa de zhi bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du yams kyi nad sogs dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa char 'bebs bshad pa la gnyis/ sngags bshad pa dang*/ char 'bebs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ṣ+toṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha ni chings gnyis/ ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bdag srungs shig badz+ra ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rdo rje bdag srungs shigabadz+ra pā ṇi phyag na rdo rje/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa a na le a ba lo ki te tsur+ṇā te dzo ra si ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi me gtsug tor lta bar mi mngon pa'i spyi gtsug gzi brjid kyi phung po zhes bsgyur ba zhig dang*/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor me ltar 'bar ba des gzigs pa phye mar gyi me'i 'od zer gyis zhes pa gnyis snang ste/ a na le ni me dang me ltar 'bar ba/ a ba lo ki te ni lta bar mi mngon pa dang des gzigs pa/ tsur+ṇā te ni spyi gtsug dang phye mar gyis/ dzo ra si ni gzi brjid kyi phung po dang me'i 'od zer zhes bsgyur ba'i khyad par ro/ /dza la ni bar ba'am sbor zhig dha ka ni sregs shig da ra ni choms shig bi da ra ni rnam par choms shig ts+tshin+dha ni chod cigabhin+dha ni chings shig

hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ni bskul ba dang gsal bar byed pa/ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor/ a na la me/ kha sa me mkha' dang mnyam pa/ bai ra 'jigs pa/ sau me zla ba/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhi ṣ+ṭha te ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis byin gyis rlobs shig sarba ta tā ga to ṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can zhes pa ste/ nas dang byung ba'i skad dod dngos su mi snang ngo*/ /hūṃ gnyis ni thugs kyi mtshon byed dang*/ ma ma zhes bdag ste rang nyid srung pa'i don no/ /uṣ+ṇī'i u ni ta'i srog gi a dang phrad stobs kyis na ror song ba ste/ mtshams sbyor lnga pa las/ i u la o'o zhes 'byung ba ltar mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /slob dpon shu rāṅga badz+ra gyis srung 'khor rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te sngags 'di bzlas nas char 'bebs pa zhig bshad do/ / gnyis pa ni/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang zhes sogs te/ char 'bebs pa'i thabs mang du yod pa las/ 'dir srung 'khor dang sngags bzlas pa'i mthus/ klu'i rgyal po rnams dgyes nas/ klu chen po brgyad dang*/ khyad par du klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang*/ dung skyong dang*/ nag po chen po ste rigs gsum gyi klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis dus dus su char 'bebs so/ /dus dus su sprin sdud pa dang*/ dus dus su 'brug sgra sgrogs par byed par 'gyur ro/ / gsum pa ni/ de ltar las grub pa la sngags bzla ba dang*/ lha'i rnal 'byor dgos shing de yang rang rang gi skabs su/ bshad pa'i sngags dang*/ 'dir sangs rgyas rnal 'byor du byas la/ rig pa'i rgyal mo 'di lan gsum la sogs pa bzla bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor kha cig shākya thub pa'i rnal 'byor du bshad kyang*/ 'di'i gzhung 'don pa la de dang*/ gzhan sangs rgyas zhes pa gdugs dkar mo can gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la byas na legs sam snyam mo/

/gsum pa mjug tu yi rang ba'i mthun 'gyur ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ zhes pa nas/ mngon par bstod do zhes pa'i bar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la dga' nas bsngags pa'o/ / gsum pa mjug gi don la gnyis/ gzhung rdzogs pa dang*/ bsgyur byang bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhes pa nas/ /gzungs rdzogs so zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ bstan pa sngar dar gyi dus bod kyi rgyal blon byang chub sems pa'i sku'i ring la bsgyur ba las/ dus phyis kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta pā ra he ta te gzhan phan bzang po dang*/ lots+tsha ba zu dga' rdor gyis kha che'i bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas kyi gtsug lag khang gi dpe rnying la gtugs nas dag par byas pa'o/ /smras pa/ bde gshegs kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i nus mtsho las/ /legs 'khrungs gtsug tor gdugs dkar lhun po'i dbang*/ /gzi byin 'phrin las nyi 'od stong 'bar ba/ /gdul bya rgya mtsho'i dpal dang mgon du gyur/ /gang gi gzugs mchog zab yang mchu gter cher/ /rnam dpyod ri rab bsgril ba las byung ba'i/ /don bzang cha shas rdzogs pa'i 'od dkar can/ /blo ldan rnam dpyod kun+da rgyas phyir shar/ /zab zab gzhung gi dgongs don pad+mo'i tshal/ /mkhas mkhas dam pa rim brgyud man ngag dang*/ /gsal gsal rigs pa'i nyi 'od kyis phye ste/ /legs legs bshad mod nyes par gyur na bshags/ /'dir 'bad las byung rab dkar gaṅga'i rgyun/ /dus gsum dge tshogs klung dang lhan cig tu/ /dad ldan blo rmongs dri ma 'khrud pa dang*/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho chen por 'jug phyir bsngo/ /ces gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can gyi gzungs kyi rgyas 'grel dgong don rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung che phra du ma dang nag rtsis skor la blo gros gsal ba g.yo sa'i dge slong grags pa dpal 'byor gyis nan cher bskul ba la brten nas/

shākya'i btsun pa grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu khyi rang lo re brgyad thog /co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i par gyi yi ge ba ni kha ton dge sbyor la brtse ba che zhing dad stobs phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// //
